DitherLogoMarquee.logos: The logos, in order. Each is { source: image }.
DitherLogoMarquee.variant: marquee scrolls, wall is a still grid with hairline dividers.
DitherLogoMarquee.logo-height: Height of each logo. The width follows its ratio.
DitherLogoMarquee.gap: Space between logos in the row.
DitherLogoMarquee.speed: Scroll speed in pixels per second.
DitherLogoMarquee.fade: How the ends fade out: soft, dither or none.
DitherLogoMarquee.backdrop: The colour the ends fade to. Set it to your page background.
DitherLogoMarquee.pause-button: A small button on hover that stops the motion.
DitherLogoMarquee.ink: Colour of the logos when tone is mono.
DitherLogoMarquee.tone: mono draws every logo in one ink. original keeps each file's own colours.
DitherLogoMarquee.outline: Keep a solid outline one cell wide, so the shapes stay exact however open the fill is.
DitherLogoMarquee.floor: Gradient fill: how much ink is left at the bottom, 0 to 1.
DitherLogoMarquee.period: Time per sweep of the effect.
